summary:
I wrote six tests for GLOSS.creature#1 at the end of tests/srd/test_glossary.py, and all six pass (green). The clause has no threshold, so there is no boundary test and no waiver.

- **Positive (3):** Cure Wounds heals another PC through Session.execute. Thunderwave hits a PC standing in its Cube. A monster is a creature target for Cure Wounds.
- **Negative (1):** an object (a door) isn't a creature, so Cure Wounds on it through the Session is refused cleanly.
- **Abuse (2):** leaving a PC off Thunderwave's list doesn't keep them out of an 'each creature' area. An object can't fill one of Bless's creature slots.

I added one new cheat to loop/abuse-catalogue.md: treating a PC as something other than a creature to spare a party member from an area effect. Stage B found nothing related to this unit, so no scenarios changed, and I proposed no rulings. ruff check and ruff format are clean.
